CFML Language Reference: Tags

CFHTTPPARAM

CFHTTPPARAM tags go between <CFHTTP> and </CFHTTP>. Each one adds a single piece of data to the request, so your template can fill in and submit another site's form.

Category

Internet protocols

Syntax

<CFHTTPPARAM TYPE="type"
    NAME="name"
    VALUE="transaction_name"
    FILE="filename">

Attributes

TYPE
Required. URL (appended to the query string), FormField (sent in the body of a POST), Cookie (sent in a Cookie header), CGI (sent as a request header of that name) or File (uploads a file in a POST).
NAME
Required. Name of the parameter, field, cookie or header.
VALUE
Optional. Value to send. Not used for TYPE="File".
FILE
Required for TYPE="File". Full path of the file to upload.

Usage

FormField and File parameters are only sent when the CFHTTP tag has METHOD="POST". A plain POST is encoded as application/x-www-form-urlencoded; as soon as one File parameter is present, the whole request switches to multipart/form-data, just as a browser does for a form with ENCTYPE="multipart/form-data".

URL, FormField and Cookie values are URL-encoded for you. Using the tag outside CFHTTP throws a Template exception.

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<!--- This page posts a form to itself; the ?Echo=Yes request just echoes what it got --->
<CFIF IsDefined("URL.Echo")>
  <CFPARAM NAME="Form.Name" DEFAULT="(missing)">
  <CFPARAM NAME="Cookie.Flavor" DEFAULT="(missing)">
  <CFOUTPUT>Name=#HTMLEditFormat(Form.Name)#; Cookie=#HTMLEditFormat(Cookie.Flavor)#</CFOUTPUT>
  <CFABORT>
</CFIF>
<CFSET Target = "http://127.0.0.1:#CGI.SERVER_PORT#/CFDOCS/snippets/cfhttpparam.cfm">
<CFTRY>
  <CFHTTP URL="#Target#" METHOD="POST" TIMEOUT="10" THROWONERROR="Yes">
    <CFHTTPPARAM TYPE="URL" NAME="Echo" VALUE="Yes">
    <CFHTTPPARAM TYPE="FormField" NAME="Name" VALUE="Ann & Andy">
    <CFHTTPPARAM TYPE="Cookie" NAME="Flavor" VALUE="Oatmeal">
    <CFHTTPPARAM TYPE="CGI" NAME="X-Requested-By" VALUE="KoldFusion">
  </CFHTTP>
  <CFOUTPUT>
  <TABLE BORDER=1 CELLPADDING=3>
  <TR><TD>Status</TD><TD>#CFHTTP.StatusCode#</TD></TR>
  <TR><TD>The other side saw</TD><TD>#Trim(CFHTTP.FileContent)#</TD></TR>
  </TABLE>
  </CFOUTPUT>
  <CFCATCH TYPE="Application">
    <CFOUTPUT><P><B>The request did not get through:</B> #CFCATCH.Detail#</P></CFOUTPUT>
  </CFCATCH>
</CFTRY>
